mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_order (order_no, customer_id, store_id, amount, payment_channel, status, verification_code, transaction_no, create_time, pay_time) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{customerId}, #{storeId}, #{amount}, #{paymentChannel}, #{status}, #{verificationCode}, #{transactionNo}, #{createTime}, #{payTime})

INSERT INTO product_order_item (order_id, product_id, product_name, product_image, price, quantity, subtotal) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{productId}, #{productName}, #{productImage}, #{price}, #{quantity}, #{subtotal})
mapper.select:
SELECT o.*, c.name AS customer_name, s.name AS store_name FROM product_order o LEFT JOIN customer c ON o.customer_id = c.id LEFT JOIN store s ON o.store_id = s.id
AND (o.order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR o.verification_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR s.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND o.status = #{status}
ORDER BY o.create_time DESC, o.id DESC

SELECT o.*, c.name AS customer_name, s.name AS store_name FROM product_order o LEFT JOIN customer c ON o.customer_id = c.id LEFT JOIN store s ON o.store_id = s.id WHERE o.customer_id = #{customerId} ORDER BY o.create_time DESC, o.id DESC
SELECT o.*, c.name AS customer_name, s.name AS store_name FROM product_order o LEFT JOIN customer c ON o.customer_id = c.id LEFT JOIN store s ON o.store_id = s.id WHERE o.id = #{id}
SELECT * FROM product_order_item WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_order WHERE verification_code = #{verificationCode}
mapper.update: UPDATE product_order SET status = 'completed', complete_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'paid'
